findings.description: Insecure raw socket usage in tools script (no TLS) exposes data in transit.
findings.code_snippet:
sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
sock.sendto(encoder.encode(msg), (sys.argv[2], 161))

substrate, _ = sock.recvfrom(2048)

# noinspection PyRedeclaration
rMsg, _ = decoder.decode(substrate, asn1Spec=msg)

findings.reasoning: The code creates a raw UDP socket and sends/receives SNMP data without any encryption or TLS. This exposes all transmitted data to interception and tampering, violating secure transmission best practices (CWE-319). SNMP v1/v2c over UDP is inherently insecure, and this code does not implement any additional security measures.
